content.title: How to Scan a Receipt on iPhone Clearly
content.meta_description: Scan long receipts on iPhone, clean up faded thermal print with high-contrast filters, and save files to date-based folders for accounting.
content.h1: Scan Receipts on iPhone for Expenses and Tax Archives
content.quick_answer: To scan a receipt on iPhone, place it on a flat surface, open Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit, and select Receipt mode. The app automatically crops long slips and applies a high-contrast filter to sharpen faint thermal text. Organise scans by date and export to iCloud Drive, Google Drive, or Files.
intro: You empty your wallet at the end of the month to find curled, crumpled slips from restaurants, fuel stations, and supermarkets. Before you can hand them to an accountant or upload them to expense software, you have to capture legible digital copies.

Thermal paper receipts fade quickly over time, often within months or a couple of years. Waiting until tax season can leave you holding blank white strips of paper where prices and item names used to be.
This guide shows you how to capture long receipts, restore legibility to faint thermal print using dedicated filters, and sort your files into date-based folders on your iPhone.
content.steps_heading: How to Scan Receipts with Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit

steps.title: Flatten the receipt on a contrasting surface
steps.detail: Lay curled slips flat on a dark table or desk. Good contrast helps the camera isolate the paper boundaries, especially on thin or wrinkled thermal sheets.

steps.title: Select Receipt mode
steps.detail: Choose Receipt mode inside Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit. This activates long-receipt capture, which handles extra-tall retail slips and applies automatic cropping to the full length of the paper.

steps.title: Capture the receipt and eliminate shadows
steps.detail: Hold your iPhone parallel to the paper. If your hands or phone block overhead light, apply the Shadow Removal filter to even out the exposure across the slip.

steps.title: Apply a high-contrast filter for faint text
steps.detail: Select the high-contrast filter to enhance faded purple or grey thermal ink against the background, ensuring numbers and dates remain readable for tax purposes.

steps.title: File into date-based folders and export
steps.detail: Save the scan into folders with date-based file names to keep your accounting archives organised. Share the finished PDF or JPG to Files, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, or Dropbox without extra fees.

content.alternatives_heading: Other Ways to Scan Receipts on iOS

alternatives.how: Create or open a note, tap the camera button, choose Scan Documents, frame the paper slip, and share the resulting scan as a PDF.
alternatives.best_for: Occasional single receipts when you already store notes inside the Apple ecosystem.
alternatives.limitation: Lacks high-contrast thermal ink filters and does not automatically file into date-based receipt folders.

alternatives.how: Snap a standard photograph of the receipt on your desk and save it directly into your Photos camera roll.
alternatives.best_for: Instant capture when you simply need a rough photo proof before tossing a slip.
alternatives.limitation: Captures background clutter without automatic perspective cropping and does not standardise documents into multi-page accounting PDFs.

content.tips_heading: Tips for Scanning Faded Thermal Receipts
tips: Digitise store slips immediately; thermal paper begins losing print density rapidly, often becoming unreadable within months.
Smooth out folds with your fingers before scanning; if fingers cast a dark blur, use the Shadow Removal filter to balance lighting.
Place narrow, long till slips against a dark background so edge detection finds the true borders of the receipt without clipping edges.
Avoid camera flash when shooting glossy thermal coatings, as glare can whitewash vendor details and totals.

faqs.question: Why should thermal paper receipts be digitised quickly?
faqs.answer: Thermal paper receipts fade over time, often within months to a few years. Scanning them soon after purchase ensures you retain readable records for tax and warranty purposes before heat and light erase the ink.

faqs.question: How does Receipt mode handle long, folded receipts?
faqs.answer: Receipt mode includes long-receipt capture, which detects and frames tall paper strips beyond standard A4 or Letter dimensions. It automatically crops the margins along the full paper slip even if it has minor creases.

faqs.question: Which filter restores readability to faint, faded thermal paper text?
faqs.answer: Receipt mode provides a dedicated high-contrast filter specifically tuned for thermal slips. This darkens faint grey print and balances the light background, rendering product names and totals legible again.

faqs.question: How do date-based file names and folders help with expense reports?
faqs.answer: Receipt mode organises scans using automated date-based folders and file names. This structures your records chronologically, making it easy to reconcile line items against monthly credit card statements and tax filings.

faqs.question: Can I export receipt scans directly to iCloud Drive or Google Drive for free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Exporting scans as PDF or JPG to iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, Mail, or the Files app is fully supported in the free version of the app.
